/* QA 이력 (9090) */
SELECT (SELECT SUBSTR('0000'||a.fhour,-4,4)||':'||SUBSTR('0'||a.fmin,-2,2)||':'||SUBSTR('0'||a.fsec,-2,2) FROM ( SELECT MOD(ROUND(a.vsec),60) as fsec , MOD(FLOOR(ROUND(a.vsec) / 60),60) as fmin , FLOOR(FLOOR(ROUND(a.vsec) / 60) / 60) as fhour FROM ( SELECT (TO_DATE(SUBSTR(REPLACE(AFT.AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM,'-',''),1,14),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') - TO_DATE(SUBSTR(Z.AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM,1,14),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) * 24 * 60 * 60 AS vsec FROM DUAL ) a ) a ) AS TIME_DIFF , TO_TIMESTAMP(Z.FOR_START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS:FF6') AS START_TIME , Z.* FROM( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO) NUM , ROW_NUMBER()OVER(ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO) + 1 AS AFT_NUM , MST.QLAS_CRPE_ENO , MST.QLAS_SNPE_ENO , A.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO , MST.ACTL_FX_REFNO , MST.FX_REFNO_SRNO , A.INPT_MST_SRNO , A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD , ATVT.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS AI_INSP_ATVT_NM , A.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD , STS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM AS AI_INSP_ATVT_STS_NM , NVL(A.AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM,A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM) AS AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM , A.AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM AS ORI_AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM , A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM , NVL(A.AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM,A.LST_DB_CHG_DTM) AS FOR_START_TIME
, A.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO AS AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO , A.AI_INPT_PRC_OPI_TXT , ENO.AI_INPT_USER_NM AS DAMDANG , ENO1.AI_INPT_USER_NM AS AI_INPT_CRPE_NM_QA , ENO2.AI_INPT_USER_NM AS AI_INPT_SNPE_NM_QA , A.TRN_LOG_SRNO , A.LST_DB_CHG_ID , '3' AS INPT_ATMC_BIZ_DSCD FROM CSPD008TH A , CSPD112TI ATVT , CSPD112TI STS , CSPD001TM MST , CSPD101TI ENO , CSPD101TI ENO1 , CSPD101TI ENO2 WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno}
AND ATVT.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = 290 AND ATVT.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD AND STS.AI_INPT_GRP_CD = 300 AND STS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD AND MST.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND ENO.AI_INPT_USER_ID (+)= A.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO AND ENO1.AI_INPT_USER_ID (+)= MST.QLAS_CRPE_ENO AND ENO2.AI_INPT_USER_ID (+)= MST.QLAS_SNPE_ENO )Z ,(SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO) NUM , NVL(AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM, LST_DB_CHG_DTM) AS AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM , LST_DB_CHG_DTM , INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno}
)AFT WHERE AFT.NUM (+)= Z.AFT_NUM
ORDER BY Z.ACTL_FX_REFNO
ORDER BY Z.ACTL_FX_REFNO DESC
ORDER BY Z.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO
ORDER BY Z.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO DESC
ORDER BY DAMDANG
ORDER BY DAMDANG DESC
ORDER BY Z.AI_INPT_PRC_OPI_TXT
ORDER BY Z.AI_INPT_PRC_OPI_TXT DESC
ORDER BY TIME_DIFF
ORDER BY TIME_DIFF DESC
ORDER BY START_TIME
ORDER BY START_TIME DESC
ORDER BY AI_INSP_ATVT_NM
ORDER BY AI_INSP_ATVT_NM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INSP_ATVT_STS_NM
ORDER BY AI_INSP_ATVT_STS_NM DESC
ORDER BY Z.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO ASC

/* QA 이력 (9090) */ SELECT COUNT(*) totcnt FROM (SELECT Z.AFT_NUM FROM(SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO) NUM , CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO)-1 != 0 THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO)-1 ELSE 1 END AS AFT_NUM FROM CSPD008TH A , CSPD112TI ATVT , CSPD112TI STS , CSPD001TM MST , CSPD101TI ENO WHERE A.INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD >= 110 AND (A.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = 3 OR A.AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD IS NULL) AND ATVT.AI_INPT_GRP_CD=290 AND ATVT.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_ACVT_CD AND STS.AI_INPT_GRP_CD=300 AND STS.AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_ACVT_STS_CD AND MST.INPT_MST_SRNO = A.INPT_MST_SRNO AND ENO.AI_INPT_USER_ID (+)= A.AI_INPT_CRPE_ENO )Z ,(SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY AI_INPT_PRG_SRNO) NUM , AI_INPT_PROS_STA_DTM , INPT_MST_SRNO FROM CSPD008TH WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND AI_INPT_ACVT_CD >= 110 AND (AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = 3 OR AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD IS NULL) )AFT WHERE AFT.NUM = Z.AFT_NUM )

/* 심사이력 (9090) 업로드한 파일 리스트들을 db에서 불러오는 쿼리 */ SELECT INPT_MST_SRNO , AI_INPT_ATFL_SRNO , AI_INPT_ATFL_NM , AI_INPT_ATFL_PATH_TXT , TRN_LOG_SRNO , LST_DB_CHG_ID , LST_DB_CHG_DTM , AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD FROM CSPD006TL WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno} AND AI_INPT_BIZ_DSCD = #{inptAtmcBizDscd}
/* 심사이력 (9090) 업로드한 파일 리스트들을 db에서 불러오는 쿼리 */ SELECT COUNT(*) totcnt FROM CSPD006TL WHERE INPT_MST_SRNO = #{inptMstSrno}
